healthPrompt.title: Next step: a health endpoint
healthPrompt.body: Uptime checks use it to know the app is up without loading pages or waking the database. Paste this into your AI coding agent:
healthPrompt.text: Add a GET /api/health endpoint to this app. It must answer HTTP 200 with the JSON '{"status":"ok"}' and Cache-Control: no-store, respond in under 100 ms, need no authentication, and must not query the database or call other services. Add a test for it.
